items.title: Phil Wilson interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, September 27, 2023
items.q: I understand that your daughter was named after Marian McPartland, is that correct? Yes that is.

ctx.x: Yeah. I appreciate all your humor and mixed with wisdom, and I understand that your daughter was named after Marian McPartland, is that correct?

items.title: Marian McPartland — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: I was doing a lot of those things, like stage-band clinics with a really nice group. Sometimes Michael Moore would be the bass player. Phil Wilson from Berklee [College of Music]. John LaPorta. ... That would be the faculty.

ctx.x: . . . I was doing a lot of those things, like stage-band clinics with a really nice group. Sometimes Michael Moore would be the bass player. Phil Wilson from

Berklee [College of Music]. John LaPorta. Another guy named Wes Hensel, who has died. You knew all those guys. That would be the faculty. Marvin Stamm was in it at various times. I did a lot of those things. Then Jimmy and I worked some gigs together. I worked at a place called the Strollers Club, where they had a British group doing . . .
